source.attribution: Educational model generated procedurally by 3D Education Engine, based on textbook descriptions of a generalised animal cell.

educational.disclaimer: Educational model — not to scale. A generalised cell; real cells vary widely in shape and contents.

cell_membrane.name: Cell membrane
cell_membrane.description: Controls what enters and leaves the cell.

nucleus.name: Nucleus
nucleus.description: Contains the cell's DNA and controls its activities.

nucleolus.name: Nucleolus
nucleolus.description: Region of the nucleus where ribosomal RNA is made and ribosomes are assembled.

rough_er.name: Rough endoplasmic reticulum
rough_er.description: Membranes studded with ribosomes; proteins made there are folded and transported.

golgi.name: Golgi apparatus
golgi.description: Modifies, sorts and packages proteins for use in or outside the cell.

mitochondria.name: Mitochondria
mitochondria.description: Site of aerobic respiration, which releases energy as ATP.

lysosomes.name: Lysosomes
lysosomes.description: Contain digestive enzymes that break down worn-out parts and engulfed material.

ribosomes.name: Ribosomes (enlarged)
ribosomes.description: Make proteins by joining amino acids in the order set by mRNA.

centrioles.name: Centrioles
centrioles.description: Help organise the spindle that separates chromosomes when the cell divides.
